meta.parties: Martin Et Al. v. Commissioner of Stamp

rules.statement: The words 'under the last preceding sub-section' in section 16(2) of the Estate Duties Ordinance, No. 8 of 1919 qualify the opening words of sub-section (2), meaning that the estate duty referred to is settlement estate duty.
rules.supporting_quote: 'On behalf of the Commissioner it is contended that the words 'under the last preceding sub-section' qualify the opening words of sub-section (2) viz., 'If estate duty has already been paid', so that the estate duty referred to is the settlement estate duty.'
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: 16 (2) If estate duty has already been paid in respect of any settled property under the last preceding sub-section since the date of the settlement, the estate duty shall not be payable in respect thereof until the death of a person who was at the time of his death, or had been at any time during the continuance of the settlement, competent to dispose of such property
